Question: Last year Mr. John Q. Public received an inheritance. He paid \(20\%\) in federal taxes on the inheritance, and paid \(10\%\) of what he had left in state taxes. He paid a total of \(\$10{,}500\) for both taxes. How many dollars was the inheritance?
